name: flat-cartoon
title: Flat cartoon
summary: Flat-vector cartoon scenes with saturated dusk and night colour, rim light and glow, and one round original character carried through every shot by a single reference still.

look.ground: generated scenes: a violet study, a coral-sunset room, a teal starry night; never a plain backdrop
look.type: Inter 700 30 px captions at 1280×720, one sentence at a time, on a dark rounded box at the bottom; no text inside the picture
look.texture: flat fills with soft gradients and a little grain; no outlines
look.light: a strong rim light on every object, soft glow and bloom on light sources, dusk or night
look.materials: flat vector shapes, matte, layered in depth

consistency: one reference still (made with Seedream 4.0) passed to every Seedance generation as --reference-image; the same style block opens every prompt

motion.feel: bouncy, elastic character acting; whatever the video model animates
moves: two shots per 12 s clip with a hard cut at 6 s
the closing shot ends on a slow push in

pace.text: one caption per sentence of narration, switching at the voice's pauses; captions always on

banned: a character, logo or look taken from an existing channel
text, numbers or formulas written by the video model
code-drawn vector art in place of illustration

generators: Seedance 2.0 (BytePlus) 12 s clips at 720p with sound

source: original, after flat-vector science channels in general
